---
title: lmd modules
---

A module written in lmd, required from a cell:

```{lmd}
local cards = require("modules/cards")
return cards.card("Hello", {=[ from a *module* ]=})
```

The same module, used over a list:

```{lmd}
local cards = require("modules/cards")
return cards.deck(pandoc.List({
  { title = "One", body = "first" },
  { title = "Two", body = "second" },
}))
```

`require` caches per document, so the module ran once:

```{lmd}
local a = require("modules/cards")
local b = require("modules/cards")
return {=: Same table: `{lmd} tostring(a == b)` :=}
```

An `.lmd` module wins over a `.lua` file of the same name, with a warning:

```{lmd}
return {=: Loaded the `{lmd} require("modules/shadowed").which` one. :=}
```

The compiler is reachable from Lua:

```{lmd}
local src = quarto.lmd.compile("return {=: compiled *at run time* :=}", "inline.lmd")
return load(src)()
```

A module that does not compile fails the requiring cell at the `require`:

```{lmd}
local m = require("modules/broken")
return m.go()
```

A module that raises names its own file and line:

```{lmd}
local m = require("modules/boom")
local r = m.go()
return r
```
